data.one_liner: Mediation adapter for AppLovin ad network via the google_mobile_ads plugin.
data.what_it_does: Enables sending ad requests to the AppLovin ad network through the Google Mobile Ads SDK in Flutter applications. It uses the Pigeon plugin to bridge the Dart layer with native platform code.
use_when: You are using the google_mobile_ads plugin and want to mediate AppLovin ads.
You need to serve ads from the AppLovin ad network alongside AdMob mediation.
avoid_when: You are not using the google_mobile_ads plugin.
you prefer integrating AppLovin MAX directly without Google Mobile Ads mediation.
strengths: Official mediation adapter supporting Android and iOS.
Keeps up-to-date with recent AppLovin SDK and adapter versions.
weaknesses: Strict dependency on the google_mobile_ads plugin version.
Limited documentation inside the package README, relies heavily on external AdMob developer guides.
data.setup_notes: Requires configuration of the google_mobile_ads plugin and following the AppLovin developer guide for Google Mobile Ads mediation.

alternatives.name: applovin_max
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want to use AppLovin MAX directly rather than through Google Mobile Ads mediation.
